method: Node keep-alive HTTP client; rotated candidate/Fast/LinguaSpark; cache disabled; GPU disabled; all host CPUs allowed.
limits: Linux x86_64 Intel i5-14400 only; no cross-platform performance claim.
AVXVNNI is runtime gated; unsupported hosts/shapes retain InvokeOp or ordinary ONNX fallback.
LinguaSpark and MTran share CPU affinity, not identical internal threading or scheduling.
Repeated 25-text corpus is not production traffic.
Core sanitizer tests do not instrument the shipped ORT shared library.
SSRU stays opt-in; increased memory and workload-dependent gains prevent a universal default claim.
Shared workstation, no exclusive CPU reservation.
Long corpus: one independent 32-sentence text per direction, repeated six times at c1 and 24 times at c4/c8 per round; repetitions are not independent quality samples.
RSS is process aggregate after all scenarios; raw/quantized/packed/workspace attribution is not separately measured.
